function ema(prices,period){
306
 
307
const k=2/(period+1);
308
 
309
let ema=prices[0];
310
 
311
for(let i=1;i<prices.length;i++){
312
ema=prices[i]*k+ema*(1-k);
313
}
314
 
315
return ema;
316
}

function RSI(data,period=14){
319
 
320
let gains=0;
321
let losses=0;
322
 
323
for(let i=data.length-period;i<data.length;i++){
324
 
325
const diff=data[i]-data[i-1];
326
 
327
if(diff>0)
328
gains+=diff;
329
else
330
losses-=diff;
331
 
332
}
333
 
334
const rs=gains/(losses||1);
335
 
336
return 100-(100/(1+rs));
337
}
